title: engine-runs-one-block
intention: The uniform inner engine exists and runs ONE existing block end-to-end: instantiated from a declared spec (domain knowledge + layer constraints as data, not code), it generates candidates, evaluates them against the constraints, decides or escalates, and writes the FULL state log — what was tried, what passed, why the winner won, what escalated — through the existing TRACE organ, consumer-typed 'training'.
why: The shell exists (learning_block: door/trace/finding/verdict/dial) and edge (b) of its charter says the door has 'machinery and no tenants'. The TRACE organ already consumer-types 'training' at write — the compile corpus has been accumulating BY DESIGN with no reader and, more importantly, with no writer recording inner-loop state: today's traces record that a door fired, not what the reasoning tried. Until the engine writes candidates-and-evaluations, infer:compile has nothing to read and the Haiku spec's whole staircase has no first stair. LIVED SYMPTOM carried from the parent: sessions spiral on smaller models because the state lives in attention; the state log is what takes it out.

falsifier.proves_green: proof beside the code, sealed under the tester; entry to BUILDME rides the chart chain and the intent berth; the WATCHME crossing requires the probe berthed and armed; exit to PROVED rides the answered chart
falsifier.proves_red: DONE when one block runs end-to-end and its state log can answer, mechanically: what was the input, what candidates were generated, what constraint killed each loser, why did the winner win, what escalated and to where. HOLLOW GUARD: a log that cannot answer those is not a state log, whatever it is called. WRONG-SHAPE TELL: any block-specific branch inside engine code — the spec carries the difference or the engine is not the engine. NON-VACUITY: at least one run must contain a REJECTED candidate (an engine that only ever generates one candidate has no evaluation loop to log).
falsifier.horizon: until the watch reports >=5 training-typed traces for the tenant block — the threshold that casts infer-compile-reads-the-traces
